title: Favorite numbers and the first tunes learned
summary: Sweet Georgia Brown, Lonesome Road, blues with Thomas; first number was Thomas's theme; Sensation Rag with Allen; waltzes, no quadrilles.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days

blocks.x: What's that, what, what were some of your favorite numbers?

Oh well they used to play all numbers like uh, Sweet Georgia Brown and Look Down That Lonesome Road and all like that all that kind of numbers. Thomas used to play all blues and different stuff like that, different kind of blues.
What was your first number? The first number you ever learned to play?
Well the first number was his theme song Meet Me and My Dreams. Uh huh. That's with his theme song. Yeah.
So with Sonny Allen what was the first number you learned? Oh with Red Allen?
Yeah. We used to play Sensation Ray, I played with Allen.
And what else, do you remember any other numbers?
Oh we played lots of numbers with Allen, of course I can't recall them, it'd been so long, you know. Uh huh. Used to play all kind of them old time numbers and waltzes and different things and.
Yeah. You played quadrill's ever? Cardrill?
Yeah. No we never played no cardrill. We played waltzes, box shots, drags, waltzes and all like that. Okay.
